title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Red Apple Ice Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Red Apple Ice captures the juicy sweetness of Red Apple balanced by a clean, icy finish. The combination of bright fruit and cool exhale makes for a crisp, refreshing vape that stays smooth from start to finish. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod arrives as a 2ml prefilled pod attached to an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, providing 12ml total of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No bottles or refills needed—just attach to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. With its dual mesh coil and draw activation, this pod delivers smooth vapour and flavour consistency for up to 6000 puffs (approx.). Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
